notes.title: a0.7.12
notes.content:
*Version a0.7.12*

> Patch to prepare for the arrival of new players through the marketing campaign and the 24/7 opening of the Lobby server. To encourage players to stay in the queue, a waiting bonus is now awarded every 30 seconds.

**Community**

- **To encourage players to wait in matchmaking, a bonus of +1 :Currency_ShadowShards: is now awarded every 30 seconds of waiting when the multiplayer servers are online.**
- **The Lobby server will now be open continuously.**
- Custom messages to highlight the server opening hours have been added.

**UI**

- Addition of some Mission icons that replace placeholders.
- The link to join Discord in the news is now clickable to make life easier for players.
- The home screen has been modified.
- A notification will appear when the multiplayer servers are online and offline.

**Balancing**

***Robots***

*Artillery*

- Stone Thrower: :Damage: 8 -> 7

*Hunters*

- Flint: :Speed: 9 -> 10
- Ovéa Bounty Hunter: :Speed: 10 -> 9, :HP: 9 -> 10

*Resource Gatherers*

- Military repairbot: :HP: 15 -> 10, :Speed: 6 -> 4, :Armor: 3 -> 4, :Damage: 2 -> 4, repair reduced from +5 :HP: to +3 :HP: during Dawn.

notes.title: a0.7.11
notes.content:
*Version a0.7.11*

> :fire: ** Patch majeur :** Les combats ne seront plus basés sur un jet de dés. A la place, la différence entre la Visée :Aim: de l'attaquant et l'Armure :Armor: du défenseur résulte dans une pénétration en pourcentage de l'Armure :Armor: . Les dégâts :Damage: d'une attaque sont donc maintenant toujours réduits par la Résilience :Resilience: et l'Armure :Armor: .

**Equilibrage**

***Robots***

*Guerriers*

- :SteelRaritySprite_old: Colossus : :Armor: 17 -> 14, :Resilience: 5 -> 8
- :ShadowRaritySprite:  Worg l'anihilateur : :Armor: 18 -> 15, :Resilience: 4 -> 7

*Chasseurs*

- :SteelRaritySprite_old: Chasseur de têtes : :Aim: 11 -> 13, :Armor: 9 -> 8
- :SteelRaritySprite_old: Shark la plaie des eaux : :Aim: 10 -> 11
- :TitaniumRaritySprite: Rift : :Aim: 9 -> 10, :Armor: 7 -> 6
- :ShadowRaritySprite: Gérard à l'épée géante : :Aim: 12 -> 15, :Armor: 9 -> 7
- :ShadowRaritySprite: Baïonnette : :Aim: 7 -> 9, :Armor: 9 -> 7

*Artilleries*

- :SteelRaritySprite_old: Avha : :Aim: 11 -> 12, :Armor: 8 -> 7
- :TitaniumRaritySprite: Mortar-READY : :Aim:  11 -> 13, :Armor: 8 -> 7, :Resilience:  7 -> 6

***Maîtrises***

*Armements*

- :IronRaritySprite: AD-DEFENSE : Coût :energy: 15 -> 20

**Bugs**

- Correction du texte de description de l'Infrastructure Station de téléportation. Merci @ngx200 
- Si le joueur possède exactement la somme nécessaire pour acheter un ou des coffres, le chiffre n'apparaitra plus en rouge.

notes.title: a0.7.10 - Balance and bug fixes
notes.content:
[i]Version a0.7.10[/i]

[b]Major balancing patch and bug fixes! Many Rank I Robots have been improved to be viable opening alternatives. Repair Masteries have been enhanced, along with other minor adjustments.[/b]

[b]Balancing[/b]

[b]Robots[/b]

[i]Infantry[/i]

- UZ06: HP 10 -> 11, Damage 5 -> 6
- P.O.I.N.G. Unit: HP 15 -> 18, Speed 5 -> 4, Armor 3 -> 4, Resilience 1 -> 0
- Expert Geometer: Move 4 -> 5, Range 2 -> 1, Resilience  1 -> 0

[i]Resource Gatherers[/i]

- EL-22 Turbine: Cost: kits 6 -> 4, stats adjusted accordingly. Its ability is now: +5 energy each time a Water tile is crossed.
- Military Repairer: No longer Ground-based, Move 3 -> 4, Armor 4 -> 3
- Flux: Move 3 -> 4, Range  3 -> 2

[b]Buildings[/b]

[i]Armories[/i]

- Laser Satellite: Cost 12 -> 13
- Air Tactics Center: Cost 11 -> 12

[i]Factories[/i]

- The Shaper: Cost 8 -> 7

[i]Labs[/i]

- Energy Channeler: Cost 10 -> 7
- The Galvanizer: Reduced the bonus from +3 Damage and +1 Aim to +2 Damage and +1 Aim for each Robot built.
- Time Accelerator: Cost 14 -> 10

[i]Demolishers[/i]

- Fairground Spud: Cost 4 -> 6

[b]Masteries[/b]

[i]Armaments[/i]

- Piercing Bullets: Cooldown 3 -> 2

[i]Destructions[/i]

- Death Wishes: Cooldown 3 -> 5

[i]Meteorology[/i]

- Marine Calm: Cost :energy: 30 -> 10

[i]Supplies[/i]

- Repair Ray: Cost :energy: 20 -> 10
- Remodel: Cost :energy: 30 -> 20
- Emergency Repair: Cost :energy: 35 -> 30
- Wrench Mastery: Cost :energy: 45 -> 30

[b]Bug Fixes[/b]

- The description text for Mines and Plasma Factories now states "Starting from Round X" rather than "After".
- The calculation of kits and energy income for the next Round is now improved.
- If a Robot had Barrage Fire selected but no longer has the necessary range, it will now no longer attack.

notes.title: Patch a0.7.9
notes.content:
Version a0.7.9

📢 New Feature! If you wish, you can request a refund for a card that has been nerfed. It will be removed from your collection, and you will receive its catalog cost in exchange.

🔥 Balance Patch and Bug Fixes! Shadow Rarity Robots of Rank IV have been moved to Rank III to better distribute this rarity across the Ranks, especially since the late game has become less omnipresent.

Major Correction: The probabilities of success and parrying an attack are now correct!

Balancing

Robots

Hunters

Prime Hunter Ovéa: Resilience: 1 -> 0, Armor: 1 -> 2
Bayonette: Changed from Rank IV to Rank III, Cost 7 kits. Its stats have been adjusted accordingly.

Infantry

The Sergeant: Infantry bonus changed from +3 Damage to +2 Damage. To bring it back to an acceptable strength.

Protectors

Sons of Talus: Changed from Rank IV to Rank III, Cost 8 kits. Its stats have been adjusted accordingly.

Resource Gatherers

Daughter of Kissir: Changed from Rank IV to Rank III, Cost 9 kits. Its stats have been adjusted accordingly.

Masteries

Resupply

Battery Sharing: Energy cost: 5 -> 0, Penalty changed from -4 Speed to -3 Speed, bonus from 10 energy to 5 energy per affected Robot. The card was too powerful for the current state of the game. Thanks @conqueror34

Bugs

Debilitating Virus has been fixed, the Building had no effect.
The Aerial Tactics Center no longer shows a +2 Move instead of +1 Move on Robots in construction. (Had no real effect) Thanks to @Poopcorn
The probabilities of a Successful or Parried attack against TitaniumRaritySprite: LEON-CAM now take into account its distance from the attacking Robot.
The probabilities of Successful and Parried attacks are now CORRECT! The percentages displayed until now were ALL wrong. (Sorry, I code with the 🍑)
